f.title: End each REMS assessment reporting interval no earlier than 60 days before submission; ensure FDA receipt by the due date
f.statement: The draft guidance's REMS document template recommends that the REMS Assessment Timetable state that the NDA/BLA holder must submit REMS assessments at the specified intervals (e.g. 18 months, 3 years and 7 years from initial REMS approval, or 6 months, 12 months and annually thereafter); that the reporting interval covered by each assessment should conclude no earlier than 60 calendar days before the submission date; and that each assessment must be submitted so that FDA receives it on or before the due date. The section does not apply to ANDAs and should not be included in an ANDA REMS document.
f.clause: Appendix: REMS Document Template, IV. REMS Assessment Timetable
f.applicability: Draft (not in force; superseded by the final FDA guidance Format and Content of a REMS Document, January 2023). Revised draft guidance, October 2017 (Revision 1).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Submission operations; Aggregate reporting

f.title: List REMS materials without the REMS programme name in material names
f.statement: The REMS Materials section should include a consolidated list of all materials mentioned in the REMS Requirements section, which are part of the REMS and must be appended to the REMS document; when listing them, the name of the REMS Program should not be included in the material name (e.g. "Prescriber Enrollment Form", not "Drug X REMS Prescriber Enrollment Form"), and headings and items that do not apply should be deleted.
f.clause: Appendix: REMS Document Template, V. REMS Materials
f.applicability: Draft (not in force; superseded by the final FDA guidance Format and Content of a REMS Document, January 2023). Revised draft guidance, October 2017 (Revision 1).
